events.body: Network notice NN-7965. State visit to Calderbridge, 14 and 14 October. Police will run rolling road closures in central Calderbridge (zones C1 to C3) between 09:00 and 15:00 UTC on both days. A segment closes about 20 minutes before the motorcade and reopens once it has passed. Police set the timings and do not share them with carriers in advance. Vans are held at Wexley Road depot or at a staging point while their segment is closed. Held consignments are delivered once routes reopen where possible; anything not delivered by 18:00 rolls to the next working day automatically. We will not give individual ETAs while closures are active. Please do not open trace requests for held consignments.

Third time this year Tumblewell Arc has let me down. My boots, DL-1280, are stuck 'due to road closure'. It's ridiculous that one motorcade means a whole city can't get its post. I want this logged as a formal complaint please.
Formal complaint from Greer Haverly about DL-1280, held today by the state visit road closures. He says this is the third disappointing delivery this year. Please log it and reply to him directly.

Hi Greer, I'm sorry about the boots. DL-1280 is held on a van by today's police road closures for the state visit. Tumblewell Arc can't give arrival times while the roads are closed; if it can't reach you by 18:00 it moves to the next working day automatically. I've passed your formal complaint to Tumblewell Arc's Customer relations team and they'll reply to you directly.
